data.one_liner: A Flutter package for declarative, strongly‑typed navigation with code‑gen support.
data.what_it_does: AutoRoute generates strongly‑typed route classes and navigation helpers from annotated router definitions. It handles deep linking, nested routes, guards and custom transitions automatically.
use_when: App needs deep linking or guarded routes
You want type‑safe arguments and reduced boilerplate
avoid_when: Very simple apps with few screens
You prefer pure runtime routing without code generation
weaknesses: Learning curve for annotations and generated code
data.setup_notes: Add auto_route to dependencies and auto_route_generator + build_runner to dev_dependencies, then run dart run build_runner build/watch to generate code.
